== Published English Original Virtual Set 8 wording ==
The original allows two always-Alter-immune Effects plus one per additional battleground. The earlier remastered full card introduces the fewer-than-four total Light icons condition and a maximum of three Effects. It still has a Used mode. The 25 June 2007 slip removes the Used mode and is a Starting Interrupt. The exact earlier full card survives in its issuer archive capture.
